name: recurrence-picker
purpose: Edit how something repeats: a RecurrenceRule (RFC 5545 RRULE subset from @absoluteui/core) built from native controls for frequency, interval, weekdays, day of month or nth weekday, month, and the end (never, on a date, after a count), with a live summary and a preview of the next occurrences in the timezone. The form value is iCalendar text (RRULE plus EXDATE/RDATE lines).
whenToUse: Repeating meetings, reminders, reports, maintenance windows, or billing cycles.
Inside an event editor next to a start and end (Schedule Picker embeds it).
whenNotToUse: One-off dates: use Date Picker or Schedule Picker without recurrence.
Hourly or minute-level repetition: not supported by the rule subset.
Arbitrary lists of dates: store them as RDATE values in code or use a date list.
responsive: Rows wrap; inline controls stay on one line when they fit and wrap below their radio otherwise. Reflows at 320 px without horizontal scrolling. Weekday toggles meet the 44 px touch target.
rtl: The fieldset follows the direction option; controls flow right to left. Weekday toggles start at the locale's first day of the week (or firstDayOfWeek).
theme: Native selects and number inputs use the shared control surface; weekday toggles use the primary fill with a heavier border when pressed (aria-pressed carries the state). Forced-colors mode uses Highlight/HighlightText for pressed days and GrayText when disabled.
timezone: The rule has no start. With `start` (PlainDateTime in `timezone`, or PlainDate for all-day series) the picker offers defaults (weekday, day, month), validates the end date, and previews occurrences expanded with DST-correct wall-clock semantics (SPEC section 8.5). An end date with a timed start becomes UNTIL at the last second of that day in the timezone, as UTC (RFC 5545).
security: All texts use textContent; option labels come from Intl and messages. The iCalendar form value is produced by core serialization, never from user HTML.
dataHandling: No persistence or network access. A hidden input carries the iCalendar text when `name` is set (empty when not repeating); disabled pickers are not submitted. EXDATE/RDATE and WKST of an existing value are preserved on edits.

budgets.metric: RecurrencePicker.create with a start and a 5-occurrence preview
budgets.budget: < 15 ms per instance in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: One rule per instance; previews up to 20 occurrences.

limitations: Controls cover one day of month or one nth weekday per month; other rules (several month days, BYSETPOS, several months) are kept as "Custom" and cannot be edited in place.
No hourly or minute frequencies; the time of day comes from the series start.
EXDATE/RDATE are preserved but not edited here.
The end date is always a date (no end time).
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
unsupported: BYWEEKNO, BYYEARDAY, BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, RSCALE (rejected by the core parser).
Negative intervals or counts above maxCount.
antiPatterns: Rebuilding a series from occurrences instead of storing the rule.
Omitting `start`: users then pick a weekday or day without defaults and see no preview.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/recurrence-picker: AuiRecurrencePicker directive ([auiRecurrencePicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/recurrence-picker: AuiRecurrencePicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
